content.text: I can see the issue! The storefront-web 3.0 pods are failing to connect to the OpenTelemetry collector at `otel-collector.observability.svc:4317`. The connection is being refused, which is causing errors and the export queue to fill up. This could be causing the application to fail or hang when handling requests. Let me search the documentation for information about how to handle OpenTelemetry failures:
